1.consolidated_definition: Ave nocturna de hasta 30 cm de longitud, de plumaje rojo oscuro con vetas negras y ojos grandes de color negro y pico corto que tiene, en los bordes, cerdas encorvadas hacia adentro. (Caprimulgidae; Caprimulgus cubanensis).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Nocturnal bird of up to 30 cm in length, with dark reddish plumage featuring black streaks and large black eyes and a short beak that has curved inwardly directed bristles along its edges. (Caprimulgidae; Caprimulgus cubanensis).
